messages.subject: response impulse function from TAR
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I´d like to know if it´s possible to calculate a response impulse function from TAR model ?

Thanks !

messages.subject: Re: [tsDyn] response impulse function from TAR
messages.body_plain:
Hi Paulo

No, there is no such feature, so far. By the way, are you aware of any IRF for AR in R? Then I guess one would need to run a GIRF instead, due to the non-linearity! You might want to look at the GIRF code, should be easy to adapt for TAR, as there's also the setar.sim() function.
https://github.com/MatthieuStigler/tsDyn/wiki/FAQ

Regards,

Matthieu
